title: Hom cochains on the sheafified free Čech nerve
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,J)$ and abelian sheafification be as in [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], let $f:E\to P$ be any map of $v$-valued presheaves of sets, and let $F$ be an abelian sheaf. For $A_\bullet=(\mathbb Z[N_\bullet(f)])^\#$, the actual alternating-face complex described in [lem-sc-presheaf-cech-sheaf-resolution], there are additive equivalences $e_n:\operatorname{Hom}(A_n,F)\simeq\check C^n(f,F)$ [def-sc-presheaf-cech-complex] satisfying $e_{n+1}(a\circ d_{n+1})=d^n(e_n(a))$ for every $n\geq0$ and every $a:A_n\to F$. Neither local surjectivity nor Ext vanishing is required.

source.place: Tag 079Z, zero-row Hom identification; additive sheafification adjunction.

proof.text: Apply Mathlib Adjunction.homAddEquiv for sheafification in each degree to obtain e_n. The target is definitionally the Hom group defining the presheaf Čech term.
Expand both alternating differentials. Preadditive.sum_comp and zsmul_comp, and additivity of e_n, express both sides as sums indexed by Fin(n+2).
For each face use Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left on its free abelian presheaf map. Finset.sum_congr combines the equalities of summands, proving differential compatibility.
